to: everyone: every socket on the game server, on both socket endpoints (`broadcast`)

fields.name: name
fields.description: The monster type of the boss that spawned. It is a key of `G.monsters`.

fields.name: x
fields.description: A map position for the event. Absent for `pinkgoo`, `crabxx`, `slenderman` and `wabbit`. It is the top-left corner of the spawn area, except for `snowman` and `dragold`: both always send `900, -800`.

confirm.note: `spawn_special_monster("tiger")` also sends `{name: "tiger", map}` (node/server_functions.js:2133), but its only caller is commented out (node/server_functions.js:2647), so it is not in `name`.

senders.what: `event_loop`: a daily or nightly boss (`crabxx`, `franky`, `icegolem`) starts. `spawn_special_monster` sends the event.
`event_loop`: the spawn timer of a seasonal boss ends (the `eventmap` list).
